m. (-ह्वः)
A kind of crane, (Ardea nivea.)
E.
क water, ह्वेञ् to call, &c. ड aff.

f. (-का)
A musical instrument: see काहला.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
1 Dry, withered.
2 Mischievous.
3 Large, excessive.
f. (-ली)
1 One of the Apsarasas or courtezans of INDRA'S heaven.
2 The sound of any tube, pipe or musical instrument.
(-ला)
A young woman.
mf. (-लः-ला)
A horn, either a cow horn, or an instrument of that shape.
m. (-लः)
1 A cock.
2 Sound in general.
3 A cat.
n. (-लं)
Indistinct speech.
adv.
Much, excessively.
E.
क pleasure, the head, &c. हल to plough or divide, with आङ् prefixed, affix अच्.
